# Harmonica Bending

> Harmonica Bending (harmonicabending.com) is a free, browser-based harmonica bending trainer and FAQ for the 10-hole diatonic (Richter-tuned) harmonica. The trainer listens through the microphone, shows how far a note has bent on a gauge and a live pitch trace, and gives specific coaching after every attempt. No download or account is needed, and audio never leaves the user's device.

## Pages

- [Harmonica Bending Trainer](https://harmonicabending.com/): Pick a key and a bend, play into the microphone, and get live pitch feedback and coaching. Supports all 12 keys plus Low D, Low E, Low F, Low G and High G; every draw bend and blow bend; and overblows and overdraws.
- [How to use the trainer](https://harmonicabending.com/how-to): Three steps: pick your harmonica's key, choose a bend on the hole map, then play into the microphone and watch the gauge settle in the green band.
- [Harmonica Bending FAQ](https://harmonicabending.com/faq): Plain answers to the ten most common bending questions, with free video lessons and sources linked under each one.
- [Privacy Policy](https://harmonicabending.com/privacy): Microphone audio is processed on-device and never uploaded; Google Analytics runs with consent in the EU, UK and Switzerland.

## Key facts

- On a standard 10-hole diatonic harmonica, draw bends are on holes 1–6: hole 1 bends a half step, hole 2 a whole step, hole 3 a step and a half, hole 4 a half step, and hole 6 a half step. Hole 5 barely bends.
- Blow bends are on holes 8–10: hole 8 a half step, hole 9 a half step, hole 10 a whole step. Hole 7 barely bends.
- The pattern is the same in every key; only the actual notes change.
- Overblows are on holes 1, 4, 5 and 6; overdraws on holes 7, 9 and 10. They raise the pitch and are an advanced technique.
- Most players get their first bend on the 4 draw or the 1 draw. Bending comes from the tongue, jaw and throat, not from drawing harder.
- In the trainer, a note counts as on target within ±20 cents, and a bend counts as "nailed" when held on target for 0.35 seconds.
- Practice results in the trainer are not saved; they reset when the page is closed. Only settings (key, bend, theme) are remembered in the browser.
